# Deploy LinkCode applications to Azure

Install LinkCode applications in your own Azure subscription with one click. Each **Deploy to Azure** button opens
the Azure portal with a guided form: you pick the subscription, resource group and region, fill in the settings, and
Azure creates the resources in your subscription. Nothing is deployed until you confirm in the portal.

## Before you deploy

- You need permission to create resources in the target resource group (for example **Contributor**) and, for apps
  that grant their managed identity access to resources, **User Access Administrator** or **Owner**.
- Applications run on Azure Container Apps. Some regions or subscriptions (free trial, sponsorship) have low quotas;
  each application page lists its requirements.
- The resources are billed to your subscription at Azure prices. Container apps scale to zero when idle where the
  application allows it.
- Some applications need an access key or licence that LinkCode gives you; the form asks for it.

## Versions

Every application keeps all released versions under `apps/<app>/<version>/`. The button on the main list always
installs the newest stable version (`apps/<app>/latest/`). Published versions never change; pin a version by using its
own button on the application page.

## Contact

Questions, a trial key or help with installation: [linkcode.pl](https://linkcode.pl).

## For maintainers

This repository only hosts built ARM templates (`azuredeploy.json`) and portal forms (`createUiDefinition.json`).
Application repositories publish new versions here on release; see [docs/publishing.md](docs/publishing.md).
Never commit source code, parameter files with values, keys or any other private material: everything here is public.
